heads.t: 快訊／雲林縣長戰況仍膠著！張嘉郡、劉建國僅差1千票 九合一開票夜戰況白熱化！截至晚間9時許，雲林縣長選戰陷入前所未有的膠著，被視為張麗善接班人的張嘉郡以172,936票，微幅領先民進黨籍對手劉建國的171,753票。雙方票數僅差1,183票、一路互咬，讓選情緊繃到最高點；目前開票作業仍在持續進行，最終當選結果仍待選委會正式公布。 23 分鐘前｜政治 快訊／雲林縣長戰況仍膠著！張嘉郡、劉建國僅差1千票 23 分鐘前｜政治
heads.en: Quickness/Winlin County's battle is still on hold! As of 9 p.m., the election of the Governor of Yun Lin County was in unprecedented fashion, with 172,936 votes in Zhang Jia County, considered to be the successor of Zhang Li-sun, and 171,753 votes in microbands for the leader of the Party against Liu. The fact that the two votes are short of 1,183 votes and have been biting each other all the way up to the highest level has made the election more difficult; the process is still ongoing and the final election results are still to be officially announced by the Election Commission. Zhang Jia County and Liu are only 1,000 votes short of politics 23 minutes ago.

heads.t: 只差268票！花蓮縣長開票超緊張 張峻喊聲請封存票匭「驗票」 花蓮縣長選舉呈現三強鼎立局面，國民黨提名的游淑貞承接傅崐萁、徐榛蔚夫婦執政資源，面對無黨籍參選的前花蓮市長魏嘉賢及現任議長張峻挑戰，泛藍分裂三腳督，也讓這次選情激烈交鋒。今（28）日正式開票，游淑貞與張峻一路難分勝負，開票接近尾聲，游淑貞拿下6萬2657票，而張峻拿下6萬2389票，雙方差距僅268票。稍早張峻正式宣布將聲請封存票匭、重新計票。 25 分鐘前｜政治 只差268票！花蓮縣長開票超緊張 張峻喊聲請封存票匭「驗票」 25 分鐘前｜政治
heads.en: In a three-strength election for the governor of florist county, who was nominated by the National Democratic Party (NDP) to take over the resources of the government of Fu Zheng, Xu Zhou Zhou Zhou Zhou and the current president, Wei Qianxian, who was elected without party membership, and the current president, who was in the midst of a challenge, the Blue Three-footed Leader, called for the vote to be sealed. Today (28th) the official ticket was issued, with Suk-jin and Chang-sun coming to an end, with 60,657 votes and 60,2389 votes, with a gap of 268 votes. Earlier, it was officially announced that the vote would be sealed and recounted. Twenty-five minutes ago, we were only 268 votes short of politics!
